sources.title: INT8 Quantization: Definition & Benefits for AI Inference
sources.snippet: What is INT8 Quantization? INT8 quantization is a critical model optimization technique for enabling real-time neural rendering and edge AI by drastically reducing computational and memory requirements.

sources.title: What Is int8 Quantization and Why Is It Popular for Deep Neural ...
sources.snippet: Summary int8 quantization converts neural network weights and activations from floating-point to 8-bit integers using scaling factors, enabling efficient integer computation. This approach reduces model size, memory use, and bandwidth requirements—often by up to 75%—making deployment on edge devices more practical.
